title: msgid_map insert TOCTOU: concurrent delete_by_cid between INSERT no-op and SELECT loses the row
description: msgid_map.rs insert: after ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING no-ops (duplicate message-id), the next SELECT cid FROM message_id_map WHERE message_id=? can return no row if a concurrent delete_by_cid ran between the INSERT and the SELECT. The subsequent .fetch_one() returns RowNotFound, which is converted to a misleading 'already exists' or 'missing' error rather than DuplicateEntry. Trigger: concurrent GC/eviction and duplicate-article ingestion on the same message-id.
